sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Rama Shankar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.216 of 2022, under Section - 306 I.P.C., Police Station- Bhopa, District- Muzaffarnagar with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. According to prosecution version, the marriage of deceased with applicant Omkar has taken place about 35 years prior to the incident.

There was some land in the name of deceased and accused persons were pressurizing her to transfer the said land in their names, due to which deceased committed suicide on 06.08.2022 by consuming some insecticide.
Applicant is husband of deceased.

The case was registered under Sections 498A, 328, 302 I.P.C. but during investigation, it Omkar Singh vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83980127/
1 was found that it is a case of suicide, hence, the said sections were dropped and replaced by Section 306 I.P.C.
4.

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased.
It was submitted that it is not believable that applicant along with his son and brother would abet his wife (deceased) to commit suicide.
After the incident, cremation was done by the accused persons.
After ten days of the incident, brother-in-law of applicant has lodged First Information Report of this case on 16.08.2022.
It was submitted that there is no evidence that applicant has abetted or instigated the deceased to commit suicide.
In fact, brother-in-law of the applicant has lodged First Information Report of this case with malafide intention.
In postmortem report, no injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death could not be ascertained, hence, viscera was preserved.
As per FSL report, aluminium phosphide has been found in viscera of deceased.
It was submitted that deceased has committed suicide due to some minor issue in fit of rage.

Co-accused Ashwani Kumar,
who is son of the deceased, has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 29.05.2024.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 01.03.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant - Omkar Singh involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the Omkar Singh vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83980127/
2 evidence.
9.
